_comment: Curated breadth grid for the home page. The featured deck is identified by featured: true (positional order is not load-bearing — the implementer should select by flag, not by index). Featured deck plays inline on click; remaining decks link through to detail pages. See HOMEPAGE-IMPLEMENTATION-PROMPT.md §5.2 and §6.3. Operator-managed via git; no DB query at home-page render. File belongs at frontend/config/homepage-featured-decks.json. Thumbnail and deck URLs follow the canonical nginx serving pattern from CLAUDE.md §15.7: https://lessoncraftstudio.com/<locale>/decks/<slug>/. The topic field supports the no-two-thumbnails-on-same-topic invariant from HOMEPAGE-SAVE-STATE.md Section 2.

decks.title: Picture Sudoku
decks._note: Featured tile — plays inline on click. Picked per Section-2 curation v1 doc: visually rich and broadly familiar; image-sudoku rendering is immediately legible as 'this is a real K-3 worksheet'; demonstrates inline-play affordance well.

decks._note: Track C Batch 1 (Tier 2 first-row event). Themed (animals) per Tier 1 storage convention; rendering localizes via topics-taxonomy.json.

_known_state_notes: Deck titles are operator-authored at app-side and stored verbatim per row in the DB. Locale heterogeneity is observable across Tier 1 (DE rows mix DE-native titles like 'Additionsspaß' / 'Wörter suchen' with English-language titles) and now extends to Tier 2 (es rows currently carry English-language titles like 'Grid Match' / 'Picture Sort' / 'Missing Pieces' / 'Chart Count' per operator authoring at first-publish time). Titles above mirror DB state verbatim; do NOT auto-translate or normalize. Per CLAUDE.md §17.5 Tier 1 EN+DE discipline + Tier 2 follow-on, operator may revise specific titles in a future content-authoring pass.
_growth_plan: Section-2 curation v1 → Track C Batch 1 stagger (3-en/3-de/2-es; dropped math-puzzle-en + matching-letter-de; added grid-match-es + picture-sort-es; commit `035852c3`) → Track C Batch 4 stagger crossing ~50% es threshold (this commit; 2-en/2-de/4-es; dropped crossword-en + more-less-de; added missing-pieces-es + chart-count-es). Composition now: themed (4) = shadow-match-en, addition-image-image-de, grid-match-es, missing-pieces-es; themeless (4) = sudoku-en, wordsearch-de, picture-sort-es, chart-count-es. featured: true unchanged on sudoku-en. 8 distinct mechanics; 2 of 4 Batch 4 mechanics introduced (missing-pieces, chart-count). When nl lands at Tier 2 Track C Batch N, swap further per Option D semantics. Tier 3+ (sv, fi, no, fr, it, da, pt) shifts when those launch.
